title: akụ ahụ nke mikpuru n'okpuru mpako
intro: Chee echiche ịnọ n'ihu nnukwu akụnụba nke na naanị iburu mkpịsị ugodi ga-eme ka ike gwụ ìgwè mmadụ siri ike. Olu gbara gị gburugburu na-akpali ịdị umeala n'obi na icheta ihe, mana nganga na-eto karịa ekele. Gịnị na-eme mgbe ihe bara ụba ghọrọ ule ma mpako na-emechi ihe ga-esi na ya pụta?
clues: E si m n'etiti ndị Mosa, mana emeghị m ihe megide ha.
E nyere m akụ̀ dị oke ọnụ ahịa nke na mkpịsị ugodi ha ga-ebu ibu arọ nke ìgwè ndị ikom siri ike.
Ndị m dụrụ m ọdụ ka m ghara inwe aṅụrị ma chọọ ndụ mgbe ebighị ebi n'echefughị ​​òkè m n'ụwa a.
Ekwuru m na ihe m nwere bụ naanị n'ihi ihe m maara.
Agara m n'ihu ndị m n'ịchọ mma, ndị chọrọ ndụ ụwa chọkwara ihe yiri nke m nwere.
Ala na ebe obibi m lodawo m, ọ dịghịkwa onye nwere ike inyere m aka ma ọ bụ onye enweghị ike inyere onwe m aka.

arabic: فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِۦ وَبِدَارِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُۥ مِن فِئَةٍۢ يَنصُرُونَهُۥ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنتَصِرِينَ
verse: And We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no company to aid him other than Allāh, nor was he of those who [could] defend themselves. (28:81)
